annotations.title: Assign an integration to an agent

description:
Assign an integration to an agent

Gives a voice agent access to one integration, so its tools become callable during a call. The integration must belong to the account that owns the agent, which for a reseller key is the customer account, not the reseller. The `enabledTools` field decides which of the integration actions the assistant may call: null means the recommended default set for that integration type, an empty array means the assistant may call nothing, and a list of tool names means exactly those tools and no others. Tool names are the `name` values from the integration tool catalogue. A list may only name tools the permissions of the integration allow (`permitted` in the catalogue, see GET /integrations/{id}/permissions); a tool outside them is refused with 422 and error code `tool_not_permitted`, while a malformed list or an unknown tool name stays a 400 `validation_error`. Assigning an integration that is already assigned returns 409. After the row is written the new tool set is pushed to the voice engine; if that push fails the assignment is rolled back and the request returns 502, so the response always reflects the live agent.

agentId.description: Identifier of the voice agent. Accepted either as the public form `agent_12` or as the bare number `12`; the prefix is stripped before the lookup.

body.description: The integration to assign, and optionally the tools to enable. Omit `enabledTools` to accept the recommended default set. Only catalogue-backed integration types accept a tool list.

enabledTools.description: Exact tools the assistant may call through this integration. Null selects the recommended default set for the integration type, an empty array disables every tool, and a list selects exactly the named tools.

integrationId.description: Identifier of the integration to assign. It must already exist on the account that owns the assistant.
